items.organizationName: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Industrial Control Systems (ICS)
items.scope: Vulnerabilities that are (1) reported to or observed by CISA, (2) affect industrial control systems or medical devices, and (3) are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.

All IQSIGHT (formerly Bosch Building Technology - Video Systems) products including end-of-life products.
All HYPR products only.
All WatchDog products.
All Black Duck (formerly Synopsys Software Integrity Group) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Black Duck that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.

All automotive and related infrastructure vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
